sentences.text: This second petition under Section 438 Cr.P.C., is filed for granting the privilege of pre-arrest bail to the petitioner, namely, Joynal Abedin @ Joynal Abedin Sheikh, apprehending their arrest in connection with Fakirganj P.S. Case No. 55/2021 registered u/s 447/365/376/506/34 of the IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
The Case diary, as called for, is placed before the Court.
It may be mentioned that by order, dated 21.10.2022 passed in AB 2316/2022 this Court has rejected the pre-arrest bail application of the petitioner.

The F.I.R. reveals that on 12.03.2021 at about 12 p.m. in the absence of the informant the F.I.R.
named persons unlawfully entered into the house and kidnapped his daughter by showing a dagger.

On 12.03.2021 and 13.03.2021, the F.I.R. named persons No. 1 & 2 forcefully raped the victim, and on 14.03.2021, the F.I.R. named persons No. 3 & 4 threatened the victim, if she disclosed the incident.
The named persons tried to sell the victim in Haryana but she was recovered from Bolirchar village.

This Court while passing the earlier pre-arrest bail application of the petitioners observed as herein below:
"On scrutiny of the case diary inclusive the statements of the victim girl under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., it is revealed that there is prima facie strong incriminating evidence against the petitioners.
The conduct of the petitioner No.4 during investigation is not satisfactory.

It is, however, noticed from the Birth Certificate available on the case diary that the date of birth of the petitioner No.2, namely, Anowar Hussain is 21.12.2005 and as such, his age on the alleged date of occurrence was 15 years 2 months.

Therefore, this court is of the opinion that the petitioner No.2 Page No.# 3/3 may be granted the privilege of pre-arrest bail as he has already joined the investigation, but not arrested and produced before the J.J.B., Dhubri.
Accordingly, the pre-arrest bail application of the petitioners No. 1, 3 and 4 stands rejected."
On perusal of the up-dated case diary, this Court finds no new ground for consideration of the anticipatory bail application of the petitioner favorably.
Accordingly, the pre-arrest bail application stands rejected.
Return the case diary.
This disposes of the anticipatory bail application.
